finding.statement: Canonical main still included evaluated_at in the training-bearing measured packet and included delta_id in both the measured packet and CLAY_FORGE_EXECUTION_REPLAY_IDENTITY/v1. Because delta_id names the evaluation/candidate envelope rather than a new measured execution, re-keying the same measured execution could produce a distinct replay identity and packet/token admission. Across fresh rebuilds, timestamp-only envelopes could also alter packet bytes/token counts.

hypothesis: Replay identity and training-bearing measured evidence must exclude envelope-only observation/evaluation keys while retaining them as provenance metadata. The same measured execution with changed evaluated_at, delta_id, candidate hypothesis, or candidate falsifier must remain one replay event; changed measured evidence under that stable identity must fail closed.
counterhypothesis: delta_id should remain replay-significant because a new evaluation identifier necessarily denotes a new measured execution.
counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_CURRENT_CONTRACT_LEVEL: delta_id is assigned at evaluation/candidate-envelope scope and is not independently bound to new execution bytes or new measurement evidence. Treating it as replay-significant permits envelope re-keying to mint another dataset event.

changes: derive measured evidence directly from the envelope-free measured packet
retain evaluated_at and delta_id as observation/provenance metadata only
define duplicate, conflict, and fresh-rebuild stability regressions

coordination.overlap_search_result: No open PR found that specifically closes delta_id envelope re-keying in Forge-to-Distillery replay identity.

go_tracks.track_a: ADVANCED_SOURCE_SCOPE: strengthens executable Forge-to-Distillery convergence by preventing envelope re-keying from minting another dataset packet.
go_tracks.track_b: ADVANCED: separates stable execution evidence identity from transport/evaluation envelope identity, a reusable Typed Entry causal-identity boundary.
go_tracks.track_c: ADVANCED_DATASET_SAFETY_SCOPE: makes future training packet identity stable under envelope-only replay while granting zero J-Space/model/training credit.

next_exact_gate: Execute tests.test_forge_distillery_envelope_replay_identity_873 plus existing replay/live-bridge regressions on this exact branch head using an explicitly admitted zero-cost execution surface. If green, refresh current main and fuse only if no successor already closes the same semantics; then require repository-bound live promotion 1->1->positive tokens with semantic envelope replay +0 and measured-evidence mutation fail-closed.
